verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API, a CRUD API for doing anything available in the web console without the UI. It also documents an HTTP API with reference endpoints for checking feature gates and logging events, so the product itself can be driven programmatically. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths, which limits machine-readable discovery but does not contradict that the API exists. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, and documented auth and rate-limit details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Overview of the Statsig HTTP API for retrieving feature gate, experiment, and dynamic config values and logging events directly without an SDK.
Evaluates one or more feature gates for a user and returns pass/fail results.
